description: This Python script defines a heartbeat monitoring test using a pipeline architecture. It sets up a pipeline with a NullProcessor, configures heartbeat monitoring, and runs the pipeline asynchronously.

classes.name: NullProcessor
classes.description: A subclass of FrameProcessor that overrides process_frame but performs no additional processing.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a Frame in a specified direction; overrides the superclass method without adding new behavior.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that sets up and runs the heartbeat monitoring pipeline.
